title: CORNELIA DE LANGE SYNDROME 4 WITH OR WITHOUT MIDLINE BRAIN DEFECTS

relationships.phenotype: CORNELIA DE LANGE SYNDROME 4 WITH OR WITHOUT MIDLINE BRAIN DEFECTS

intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that Cornelia de Lange syndrome-4 with or without midline brain defects (CDLS4) is caused by heterozygous mutation in the RAD21 gene (606462) on chromosome 8q24.11.

checks.claim: Cornelia de Lange syndrome-4 with or without midline brain defects (CDLS4) is caused by heterozygous mutation in the RAD21 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: RAD21 variants can lead to a CdLS phenotype (RAD21-CdLS). The (limited) available information of individuals from cohort B suggests that biallelic RAD21 variants can also lead to Mungan syndrome and monoallelic RAD21 variants to holoprosencephaly (like one case in cohort A)
checks.explanation: The paper says RAD21 variants cause CdLS, with or without holoprosencephaly-spectrum midline defects. The CdLS cases are monoallelic: de novo or familial single-allele variants, set against biallelic Mungan syndrome.

checks.claim: The RAD21 gene is located on chromosome 8q24.11.
checks.evidence_quote: human mutations in the integral cohesin structural protein RAD21
checks.explanation: The chromosomal location is standard nomenclature added by the draft. The abstract does not state it, but under the rules this counts as supported.

paragraphs.text: Cornelia de Lange syndrome-4 (CDLS4) is a cohesinopathy caused by heterozygous mutation in RAD21 (Krab et al., 2020), which encodes an integral structural protein of the cohesin complex (Deardorff et al., 2012). Affected individuals have features that overlap those of classic Cornelia de Lange syndrome, including growth retardation, facial features, and minor skeletal anomalies, but their cognitive impairment is much milder than in classic CdLS (Deardorff et al., 2012). Some patients have midline brain defects in the holoprosencephaly spectrum (Krab et al., 2020).

checks.claim: Cornelia de Lange syndrome-4 (CDLS4) is a cohesinopathy.
checks.evidence_quote: Variants in genes encoding various structural or functional components of the cohesin complex, including RAD21, SMC1A, SMC3, BRD4, STAG1/2, NIPBL, HDAC8, WAPL, ANKRD11 and in single individuals PDS5A and ESPL1, have been implicated in Cornelia de Lange Syndrome (CdLS)
checks.explanation: RAD21 is a cohesin component and its variants cause CdLS, which makes CDLS4 a cohesinopathy. The paper does not use the word itself.

checks.claim: CDLS4 is caused by heterozygous mutation in RAD21.
checks.evidence_quote: RAD21 variants can lead to a CdLS phenotype (RAD21-CdLS).
checks.explanation: The cases are de novo or familial single-allele variants, set against the biallelic variants that cause Mungan syndrome. The paper uses 'monoallelic' explicitly only for holoprosencephaly.

checks.claim: RAD21 encodes an integral structural protein of the cohesin complex.
checks.evidence_quote: human mutations in the integral cohesin structural protein RAD21
checks.explanation: The abstract directly describes RAD21 as an integral structural protein of the cohesin complex.

checks.claim: Individuals with CDLS4 have features that overlap those of classic Cornelia de Lange syndrome, including growth retardation, facial features, and minor skeletal anomalies.
checks.evidence_quote: Children with RAD21 mutations display growth retardation, minor skeletal anomalies, and facial features that overlap findings in individuals with CdLS.
checks.explanation: The abstract lists the same features: growth retardation, minor skeletal anomalies and CdLS-like facial features.

checks.claim: Cognitive impairment in individuals with CDLS4 is much milder than in classic Cornelia de Lange syndrome.
checks.evidence_quote: these individuals have much milder cognitive impairment than those with classical CdLS.
checks.explanation: The abstract states this directly.

checks.claim: Some patients with CDLS4 have midline brain defects in the holoprosencephaly spectrum.
checks.evidence_quote: Holoprosencephaly spectrum anomalies have been linked to several cohesin genes (Kruszka et al. 2019), including RAD21, although in one individual this remains uncertain (Table S6).
checks.explanation: The paper links RAD21 to holoprosencephaly-spectrum anomalies, including one case in cohort A.

paragraphs.text: Deardorff et al. (2012) described individuals with RAD21 mutations. Their features overlapped with those of Cornelia de Lange syndrome and included growth retardation, minor skeletal anomalies, and facial features that overlapped those seen in CdLS. Unlike children with mutations in NIPBL, SMC1A, or SMC3, these individuals had much milder cognitive impairment than those with classic CdLS.

checks.claim: Deardorff et al. (2012) described individuals with RAD21 mutations whose features overlapped with those of Cornelia de Lange syndrome.
checks.evidence_quote: Children with RAD21 mutations display growth retardation, minor skeletal anomalies, and facial features that overlap findings in individuals with CdLS.
checks.explanation: The abstract says the children's features overlap with CdLS.

checks.claim: The individuals with RAD21 mutations described by Deardorff et al. (2012) had growth retardation.
checks.evidence_quote: Children with RAD21 mutations display growth retardation
checks.explanation: Growth retardation is stated directly.

checks.claim: The individuals with RAD21 mutations described by Deardorff et al. (2012) had minor skeletal anomalies.
checks.evidence_quote: Children with RAD21 mutations display growth retardation, minor skeletal anomalies
checks.explanation: Minor skeletal anomalies are stated directly.

checks.claim: The individuals with RAD21 mutations described by Deardorff et al. (2012) had facial features that overlapped those seen in Cornelia de Lange syndrome.
checks.evidence_quote: facial features that overlap findings in individuals with CdLS
checks.explanation: Facial features overlapping CdLS are stated directly.

checks.claim: Unlike children with mutations in NIPBL, SMC1A, or SMC3, the individuals with RAD21 mutations described by Deardorff et al. (2012) had much milder cognitive impairment than those with classic Cornelia de Lange syndrome.
checks.evidence_quote: Notably, unlike children with mutations in NIPBL, SMC1A, or SMC3, these individuals have much milder cognitive impairment than those with classical CdLS.
checks.explanation: The abstract states this directly, including the comparison with NIPBL, SMC1A and SMC3.

paragraphs.text: Kruszka et al. (2019) found variants in cohesin complex genes, including RAD21, in patients with holoprosencephaly. They concluded that these findings showed the cohesin complex to be an important regulator of median forebrain development.

checks.claim: Kruszka et al. (2019) found variants in cohesin complex genes, including RAD21, in patients with holoprosencephaly.
checks.evidence_quote: Additionally, we report four individuals with variants in the cohesin complex genes that are not X-linked, SMC3 and RAD21.
checks.explanation: The abstract reports holoprosencephaly linked to variants in cohesin genes, RAD21 among them.

checks.claim: Kruszka et al. (2019) concluded that the cohesin complex is an important regulator of median forebrain development.
checks.evidence_quote: These findings show the cohesin complex as an important regulator of median forebrain development and X-linked inheritance patterns in holoprosencephaly.
checks.explanation: The abstract states this conclusion directly.

paragraphs.text: Deardorff et al. (2012) described the RAD21 missense mutations in their patients as dominant.

checks.claim: Deardorff et al. (2012) described the RAD21 missense mutations in their patients as dominant.
checks.evidence_quote: Our data suggest that, compared to loss-of-function mutations, dominant missense mutations result in more severe functional defects
checks.explanation: The abstract refers to the missense mutations as dominant.

paragraphs.text: Cornelia de Lange syndrome is genetically heterogeneous (Deardorff et al., 2012). Krab et al. (2020) noted that variants in other genes encoding structural or functional components of the cohesin complex, including NIPBL, SMC1A, SMC3, and HDAC8, have been implicated in CdLS.

checks.claim: Cornelia de Lange syndrome is genetically heterogeneous.
checks.evidence_quote: unlike children with mutations in NIPBL, SMC1A, or SMC3, these individuals have much milder cognitive impairment than those with classical CdLS.
checks.explanation: The abstract names several genes linked to CdLS (NIPBL, SMC1A, SMC3) plus RAD21, so genetic heterogeneity follows directly, although the word 'heterogeneous' is not used.

checks.claim: Krab et al. (2020) noted that variants in other genes encoding structural or functional components of the cohesin complex, including NIPBL, SMC1A, SMC3, and HDAC8, have been implicated in Cornelia de Lange syndrome.
checks.evidence_quote: Variants in genes encoding various structural or functional components of the cohesin complex, including RAD21, SMC1A, SMC3, BRD4, STAG1/2, NIPBL, HDAC8, WAPL, ANKRD11 and in single individuals PDS5A and ESPL1, have been implicated in Cornelia de Lange Syndrome (CdLS)
checks.explanation: NIPBL, SMC1A, SMC3 and HDAC8 are all in the paper's list.

paragraphs.text: Deardorff et al. (2012) identified mutations in the RAD21 gene in patients with a congenital phenotype consistent with a cohesinopathy that overlapped with CdLS. Mechanistically, the mutations acted at the interface of RAD21 with the other cohesin proteins STAG2 and SMC1A, and they impaired the cellular DNA damage response.

checks.claim: Deardorff et al. (2012) identified mutations in the RAD21 gene in patients with a congenital phenotype consistent with a cohesinopathy that overlapped with Cornelia de Lange syndrome.
checks.evidence_quote: human mutations in the integral cohesin structural protein RAD21 result in a congenital phenotype consistent with a "cohesinopathy."
checks.explanation: The abstract states this directly, and the overlap with CdLS is described in the same abstract.

checks.claim: The RAD21 mutations identified by Deardorff et al. (2012) acted at the interface of RAD21 with the cohesin proteins STAG2 and SMC1A.
checks.evidence_quote: Mechanistically, these mutations act at the RAD21 interface with the other cohesin proteins STAG2 and SMC1A
checks.explanation: The abstract states this directly.

checks.claim: The RAD21 mutations identified by Deardorff et al. (2012) impaired the cellular DNA damage response.
checks.evidence_quote: impair cellular DNA damage response
checks.explanation: The abstract states this directly.

paragraphs.text: In a study of cohesin-associated holoprosencephaly, Kruszka et al. (2019) identified RAD21 variants in patients with holoprosencephaly.

checks.claim: In a study of cohesin-associated holoprosencephaly, Kruszka et al. (2019) identified RAD21 variants in patients with holoprosencephaly.
checks.evidence_quote: Additionally, we report four individuals with variants in the cohesin complex genes that are not X-linked, SMC3 and RAD21.
checks.explanation: The abstract counts four individuals across SMC3 and RAD21 together. It does not say how many have RAD21 variants, so the plural 'patients' is not confirmed. That breakdown would be in the full text, which was not supplied.
